_comment: Pinned content hashes for skills vendored with source=local in .agents/.skill-lock.json (AID-2592). Algorithm matches @tech-leads-club/skills-catalog computeSkillHash: sha256 over sorted (relative path, bytes) pairs of the skill tree, skipping dotfiles/dotdirs and __pycache__. If this guard fails without a deliberate re-vendor, an `agent-skills update` overwrote local hot-fixes (the catalog still ships the pre-fix checker) - restore the tree from git history. After the upstream fix is released and you consciously re-vendor, update the pin in the same PR via: python3 scripts/skill_vendored_guard.py --update-pins
